run_daemon.description:
Whether inadyn should run in daemon mode. Must be 'yes' or 'no'.
    enum: ['yes', 'no']

run_ipup.description:
Whether inadyn should run on every new ppp connection (dial-on-demand). Must be 'yes' or 'no'.
    enum: ['yes', 'no']

user.description: User account under which inadyn runs.
